title: INFRA — Pipeline output validator cron (verify captioned videos are playable)
description: Add ffprobe-based validation cron that scans all pipeline output directories for video files and verifies they are playable. Writes a JSON report to reports/pipeline-validator-latest.json and sends Telegram alert on failures. Runs daily via PM2 cron.

tasks.title: Create scripts/scs001/validate-pipeline-output.ts — ffprobe validator + Telegram alert
tasks.description: Scan workspace/scs001/pipeline-runs/ and workspace/scs001/v2-output/ for .mp4/.mov files. Run ffprobe on each to verify duration>0 and no codec errors. Write JSON report to reports/pipeline-validator-latest.json with {checked, passed, failed, errors[]}. If any fail, POST Telegram alert using TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (https.request, no external deps). Max 150 lines.

tasks.title: Add PM2 cron entry to ecosystem.config.js for daily validation
tasks.description: Add a new PM2 app entry 'scs001-validator' with cron_restart: '0 6 * * *' (6am daily) that runs scripts/scs001/validate-pipeline-output.ts via ts-node. autorestart: false, watch: false.
